meta.source: Reserve Bank of India (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Policy rates and auction results are final when announced. The Handbook restates a few effective dates between editions (newest edition wins, differences listed in rates-policy meta). Lending and deposit rates: each monthly release repeats the full history; the newest release wins.
meta.coverage: The overnight interbank rate, every trading day since April 2005: weighted average call rate, the day's lowest and highest deal, and turnover
meta.note: RBI, Daily Weighted Average Call/Notice Money Rates (DBIE report 198, Handbook of Statistics), ACTUALS rows. One row per day the market traded. The weighted average call rate is the RBI's operating target since May 2011.
